## Remarks

This constructor accepts an optional process object parameter, enabling dependency injection for testing scenarios. When no process object is provided, the global Node.js <code>process</code> is used automatically.

The injected process object must implement the <code>platform</code> and <code>arch</code> properties from the <code>NodeJS.Process</code> interface.
